title: Trainee Business Analysis Manager | No experience needed (Ref: 8101)
description:
BUSINESS ANALYST TRAINEESHIP


Become a Business Analyst and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in solving business problems, improving processes, and helping organisations make better decisions? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers value across a wide range of industries?

We are offering a Business Analyst Traineeship designed to help aspiring business analysts develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:

  • Business Analysis Fundamentals

  • Requirements Elicitation Techniques

  • Stakeholder Analysis and Management

  • Business Process Modelling

  • Process Improvement and Optimisation

  • Requirements Documentation

  • User Stories and Acceptance Criteria

  • Agile and Scrum Methodologies

  • Waterfall Project Delivery

  • Gap Analysis

  • Root Cause Analysis

  • Business Case Development

  • Data Analysis and Visualisation

  • Change Management Fundamentals

  • Risk Analysis

  • Business Analysis Tools and Techniques

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic business analysis projects that may include:

  • Business process mapping

  • Requirements gathering exercises

  • Stakeholder analysis

  • Writing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)

  • Creating Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS)

  • User story development

  • Gap analysis reports

  • Business case preparation

  • Process improvement recommendations

  • Portfolio projects demonstrating your analytical and problem-solving skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:

  • Have an interest in business, technology, and problem-solving

  • Enjoy analysing information and identifying opportunities for improvement

  • Have strong communication and organisational skills

  • Pay close attention to detail

  • Are willing to learn new skills

  • Can work independently and manage their time effectively

  • Have basic computer skills

No previous Business Analysis experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Business Analysis training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits

  • Remote and flexible learning

  • Industry-relevant curriculum

  • Portfolio development opportunities

  • Practical project experience

  • Mentoring and personalised feedback

  • Career guidance and employability support

  • Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements

  • A good level of written English

  • Access to a computer and internet connection

  • Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:

  • Business Analyst

  • Junior Business Analyst

  • Business Systems Analyst

  • Process Analyst

  • Functional Analyst

  • Requirements Analyst

  • Change Analyst

  • Operations Analyst

  • Product Analyst

  • Business Improvement Analyst

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Business Analysis and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a rewarding career in Business Analysis.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations — you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
